ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

2. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.

3. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

4. When practising Language Use, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Use.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language Use.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Use.
